findings.highlight: No one told me anything about the stench.
findings.evidenceJa: 鼻が曲がるどころの話じゃねえな
findings.governingReading: 鼻が曲がるどころの話じゃねえ intensifies how foul the smell is beyond the usual idiom.
findings.explanation: A stench beyond the nose-bending idiom becomes nobody telling him about it.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターは上品だった
findings.governingReading: 醜悪さ being worse grounds 上品だった as more refined or genteel by comparison.
findings.explanation: Caster’s comparative elegance becomes impressive work.

findings.highlight: someone might have switched heads with her.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭をすげ替えられたって線もある
findings.governingReading: 頭をすげ替えられた is the replacement-of-leadership idiom, offered as another explanation for the changed site after her death.
findings.explanation: Replacement of the head or controlling authority becomes someone switching heads with Caster.

findings.highlight: it was living amongst the mountain beasts.
findings.evidenceJa: 山奥で獣と暮らしていた面ァしてやがる
findings.governingReading: 山奥で獣と暮らしていた面ァ describes the look of the lurking enemy’s face, not authenticated biography.
findings.explanation: A face suggesting mountain-beast life becomes established past residence.

findings.highlight: it's yours that's ripe for the taking.
findings.evidenceJa: 何よりおまえにとっちゃ命取りだ
findings.governingReading: 二度とはするな and 何よりおまえにとっちゃ命取り link the repeated action to its lethal consequence for the opponent.
findings.explanation: Repeating the projectile attack being fatal to the attacker becomes his life being available to take.

findings.governingReading: 分の刻を要する marks needing minutes as an unexpectedly long pursuit for Lancer.
findings.explanation: Minutes of pursuit become more than a moment.

findings.highlight: if I'd known the pain would drive him into flight.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みで止まらねえんなら
findings.governingReading: 痛みで止まらねえんなら explains why a disabling cut would have been preferable: pain does not immobilize him.
findings.explanation: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.

findings.highlight: now I have to clean up this mess.
findings.evidenceJa: つい後回しにしちまった
findings.governingReading: つい後回しにしちまった says he deferred the method because it does not work on the others.
findings.explanation: Putting that tactic off becomes having to clean up a mess.

findings.highlight: the severing of one's limbs or major arteries
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ
findings.governingReading: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ names cuts at limb junctions and major arteries.
findings.explanation: Cutting at limb roots becomes severing limbs.

findings.highlight: if one were to cripple all four limbs
findings.evidenceJa: これが四肢の無力化になると話は別だが
findings.governingReading: 四肢の無力化 is limb disablement in contrast with bleeding; the next example considers disabling a single arm.
findings.explanation: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.

findings.highlight: cleave the fleeing water strider from the left hip
findings.evidenceJa: 水蜘蛛の左足大腿部を一閃しかけ
findings.governingReading: 左足大腿部 identifies the left thigh as his aimed strike, interrupted by his retreat.
findings.explanation: A left-thigh strike becomes cleaving from the left hip.

findings.highlight: they barely even manage to slow the thing down.
findings.evidenceJa: 足止めにさえならない
findings.governingReading: 足止めにさえならない denies even a delaying effect despite the defense’s Noble Phantasm resistance.
findings.explanation: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.

findings.highlight: I wiLL gAIN THE KNOWlEdGe I lack.
findings.evidenceJa: タリナい知能ヲ、補ワネバ
findings.governingReading: 経験不足 and 足りない知能 distinguish experience from intellectual capacity the attacker wants to supplement.
findings.explanation: Acquiring lacking intelligence becomes acquiring knowledge.
